# Certificate in Financial Market and Algorithmic Trading (CFMAT)

A 52-week, practitioner-led programme that takes learners from how markets work to researching,
building, risk-managing, monitoring and paper-trading systematic strategies — with Python,
databases, statistics, derivatives, machine learning, NLP/RAG and n8n — and the research honesty
to tell an edge from a lucky backtest.

## Repository layout

```
course/       the programme: manifest (course.yaml), mission, fees, calendar, assessment, routes, operations
curriculum/   one folder per module: micro-level guide (README.md) + labs (lab_NNx_*.py)
cfmat/        the course library, 15 subpackages (data, analytics, derivatives, strategies,
              backtesting, research, portfolio, microstructure, trading, automation, ml,
              nlp, econometrics, viz, infra) + cfmat.studio
tools/        route_manager.py (validate + render the manifest), gen_api_docs.py
tests/        one test file per subpackage, layout and course checks, lab smoke tests
n8n/          three importable workflows (signal alerts, news digest, trade-journal webhook)
docs/         repository map, generated API reference, architecture decision records
audit/        devil's-advocate reviews
data/         your own price files (git-ignored)
```

## Quick start

New to Python or virtual environments? Follow the [setup and run guide](course/12-setup-and-run-guide.md):
which Python to install, the environment, the must and optional steps, and the order to run the labs.

```bash
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate      # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt                          # tested versions (Python 3.11 or 3.12)
make check                                               # lint, unit tests, manifest + docs checks
python curriculum/m00-prework/lab_00a_environment_check.py
python tools/route_manager.py week 25                    # what happens in Week 25
python tools/route_manager.py route derivatives-trader   # a learner route
make labs                                                # run every ready lab
```

Python 3.10+ is supported (`pip install -e ".[dev,boost]"`). Everything runs offline. The optional
LLM step in M22 uses the Claude API when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set.

## How the repository stays consistent

- **One source of truth.** `course/course.yaml` defines modules, weeks, hours, labs, fees, routes and assessment. `tools/route_manager.py check` validates it against the repository, and the tables between `<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->` markers in the docs are rendered from it.
- **Tested library.** Unit tests per subpackage, regression tests for every bug in the [audit](audit/2026-09-devils-advocate-review.md), and every ready lab run as a smoke test.
- **CI on every push.** Lint, unit tests on Python 3.10/3.11 (pinned)/3.12, labs, the manifest and API-docs checks, and a wheel installed outside the repository.
